props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once the last digit lands. Return false to reject and shake.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — what the code is for.

props.name: errorMessage
props.defaultValue: 'That code was not right. Try again.'

props.name: extra
props.type: { label: string; onSelect: () => void; glyph?: string }
props.description: Extra key in the bottom-left — biometrics, "forgot", anything.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
